roles.description: The disk in a 64DD drive. Its save is an n64dd one.
The game cartridge's own save memory, whether battery-backed SRAM, EEPROM or flash.
Save storage built into the console itself, as distinct from anything removable: a Wii's NAND included.
The Neo Geo memory card, which an arcade cabinet and a home console both take.
The only socket, or the principal one. The default: a part with no role means this.
An add-on that extends the console's own save storage rather than replacing it. Saves can be in both.

prefixes.description: N64 Controller Pak slots, one per controller port.
Sides of a disk that are written separately, in the game's own order.
Memory card slots, in the console's own order.
N64 Transfer Pak slots, one per controller port.
